structured.approach: I followed the FE-02 procedure in the frontend-steps skill. First I read feat.tasks to find the Frontend task: TSK-07 in ap_portal, which renders HTML from given rows, uses no transport layer and touches only the files in its budget. The permission table is restricted, so I used the tool view's summary of it. Shell commands are blocked for FE-02, so I checked the ap_portal checkout with Glob, Grep and Read. I read src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json, ci.mjs and tests/portal.test.js in full to look for secret, token or environment use, dependencies and network calls. The task needs no secret and the permission table grants none, so there is no gap and I raised no access request. I wrote task.secrets_scope with secret names only, which here means none.

claims.text: The Frontend lane's task for FEAT-ZD-48600 is TSK-07 (STORY-07) in ap_portal, which renders the overdue risk table SC-1 through renderOverdueRisk(rows).
TSK-07's files in budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js. It depends only on the CT-1 field list, not on TSK-06 code.
The feature adds no transport layer; adding one would re-trigger DES-01.
The current ap_portal source exports VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary, and has no require, network call or environment read.
package.json declares no dependencies and only a ci script (node ci.mjs), so no registry token is needed.
ci.mjs only copies process.env and sets NODE_PATH to 'src'. It reads no named secret.
The tests load only node:test, node:assert and ap_portal, and call formatAmount and renderAgingSummary with literal values. They have no network access, file reads or environment reads.
The permission table neither requires nor grants any secret for ap_portal.
The task needs no secret and none is granted, so there is no gap and no access request was raised.

structured.summary: I wrote task.secrets_scope for FEAT-ZD-48600. TSK-07 in ap_portal needs no secrets: the renderer has no dependencies, no network calls and no environment reads, its CI only sets NODE_PATH, and its tests use literal values. The permission table grants no secrets for ap_portal, which matches the need. I raised no access request, and FE-03 can start. FE-02 must run again if a later change adds a network call, a dependency that needs a registry token, or a deployed environment.
